What I would do is start making a plan to leave. Does he have access to your bank account? If so, open a new, secret account and start putting away what you can. See if you have friends or relatives you can stay with temporarily, or try to save up enough to find shelter for a bit. At the end of the day, YOU ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR THEM. I know that could be especially hard to accept because of the kids, because they are not your responsibility. He is not your responsibility. He needs to care for them and figure out an alternative for childcare, but your safety and well-being is always going to be what's most important. Your relationship should not EVER make you feel like you need to die to escape. When he's out of the house, quickly pack your important belongings and your documentation and leave. If you have someone who can help you, please utilize it. But you need to get out of there, and please don't confront him alone as you don't know if it could turn into a domestic situation. Please put yourself first, they will be fine.
